Frame the defining action and tool centrally so it reads clearly as a 56-pixel square thumbnail; simple authentic neutral interior or location, daylight or natural service lighting, real skin and material texture, anatomically plausible, quiet cream/warm-neutral palette when natural. No lettering, logos, numbers, watermark, borders, collage, graphic overlay, artificial bokeh shapes, or manufactured product-ad posing.
